title: Introduce sidecar metadata augmenter and contextual release clipper
author: Priya Varma
description: Motivation: Add a lightweight "sidecar" service that augments model profiles at intake time with runtime telemetry hints, provenance snippets and prioritized impact signals, and a companion 'release clipper' that generates minimal, contextual changelog fragments automatically for model version rollouts. This reduces manual churn when onboarding models and helps signal which metadata deltas are likely to affect serving economics or quality. Design overview: (1) augmenter sidecar runs during profile ingestion and attaches: sampled latency histograms, hardware-affinity hints, embedding-dimension provenance, and a small 'culprit' tag computed by delta heuristics; (2) release clipper consumes profile metadata deltas and telemetry to emit a compact one-line changelog entry + 2-line rationale suitable for release notes and downstream consumers. Implementation highlights: new microservice written in Python using async intake, small redis cache for ephemeral affinity lookups, delta scorer library shared with registry core. Backwards compatibility: sidecar augments are additive to existing profile schema; no mandatory fields are removed. Checklist: - implement augmenter service and unit/integration tests; - wire clipper into release pipeline; - add short docs and onboarding guide; - add e2e test that covers a model intake -> augmenter -> clip generation. Related: ENG-1987 for priority sampling; SUP-4321 support ticket requested more granular changelogs. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated rollout for 2 weeks with telemetry on clipped-changelog-usage; opt-out label for customers who require pristine profile blobs. Notes: kept changelog snippets intentionally conservative to avoid noisy releases; scoring heuristics tuned to favor performance-impacting changes (kv-cache-affinity, seq-length-profile shifts, quantization metadata).

release_notes: Add sidecar metadata augmenter to attach runtime telemetry and provenance to model profiles; introduce contextual release clipper to auto-generate concise changelog snippets highlighting high-impact metadata deltas. notes_for_oncall: If autotagged changelogs appear noisy, reduce sampling window via AUGMENTER_SAMPLING_WINDOW_SECONDS or temporarily disable feature flag 'sidecar-augmenter' in the feature flag service. Monitor metric registry.augmenter.clipper.emitted_count for surge.
